integrity: For each arm, the leaf is the unique vertex distinguishing its support vertex from the incident leaf edge, forcing every mixed resolving set to contain every leaf. The full leaf set has explicit pairwise distinct mixed representations, but it misses the center under domination. Exactly one added center-or-support vertex is therefore necessary and sufficient.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to once-subdivided stars with at least three arms.
Finite exhaustive verification covers q from three through eight and is corroborative only.
The result does not address spiders with unequal or longer arm lengths.
A differently phrased or non-indexed treatment may exist.
title: Dominant mixed metric bases of once-subdivided stars
